scientific_integrity: Infinite result relies on a proved transfer bijection plus exact integer characteristic-polynomial computation; the standard-library verification script computes the needed determinant factors and independently checks the smallest four cases. No independent audit or external certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Counts reduced optimal colorings only (all nonempty classes of size one or two), with vertex labels fixed and color names factored out; does not count larger classes or unlabelled graph orbits. Earlier equivalent formulations remain a priority risk.
title: Exact reduced-optimal sub-quorum coloring enumerator of circular ladders
